    Profile

    Lucretia is a princess knight from Envylia. Bold rumors say that she walks the streets by herself, and that no one would have her as a bride. She's a genius at basically anything, but even though she'll deny it every time, she's completely terrible at cooking. In her harsh daily training to be a bride, her greatest challenger is the kitchen knife, which she's much more terrible at handling than her sword.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 158cm
    Weight: 46kg
    Birthday: May 3
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Ladylike dresses
    Hobbies: Going into town incognito
    Illust: 芳住和之
    CV: 園崎未恵
